messages:
anna.docs: Quick sync — I'm updating the SOC2 retention docs to include cross-region examples (US vs EU) and need a short guidance snippet for data egress + retention. Also the Ruby SDK link in the examples 404s. PTAL?

sam.legal: thanks for flagging. For SOC2 wording we should avoid implying we store customer data outside their chosen region by default. Suggest sentence: \"We retain audit logs per customer retention settings; when customer data crosses regions (e.g., for backup or failover), we apply the same retention and access controls and document transfer processes.\" Does that sound right?

anna.docs: that wording is great, + can we add an explicit example for 30d vs 365d retention scenarios? simple table-ish bullet examples would help customers pick presets.

devon.eng: re: SDK link — the Ruby example file moved during the SDK restructure. New path is https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-ruby/blob/main/examples/audit_export.rb (we should point to the example, not the raw file). I'll add a redirect in the repo.

lina.prod: for cross-region example, can we show a small flow: EU tenant with retention=365, failover to us-west for DR, show that retention still 365 and mention KMS key residency? customers always ask about KMS.

sam.legal: add: \"Keys used to encrypt tenant data remain under the customer's selected KMS region; cross-region copies are encrypted with a customer-managed key when required.\" Keeps things clear.

anna.docs: perfect. Draft below — comments welcome before I open a PR: 

- Scenario A: EU tenant, 365d retention. Backup copies stored in US for DR only; retention policy and access controls preserved. Reference: SOC2 section on data lifecycle.
- Scenario B: US tenant, 30d retention. Logs archived to cold storage in-region; no cross-region replication.

SDK snippet to include (Ruby):
```ruby
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_KEY'], region: 'eu')
export = client.audit_logs.export(tenant_id: 't-123', retention_days: 365)
puts export.url
```

anna.docs: also adding a small note: \"If you require strict region residency, contact sales for a Private deployment (VPC/on-prem)\"

devon.eng: lgtm. Small nit: use `region: 'eu-west-1'` in the snippet so it's clear it's a region code. Also add a one-line code comment about KMS: `# uses customer-managed KMS in region`

anna.docs: updated snippet and I'll swap the link. I'll open PR in ~30m. tagging @sam.legal for final legal ok. :eyes:

sam.legal: approve pending minor edit: replace "Backup copies stored in US" with "Backup copies may be stored in US for DR purposes" — softer language.

anna.docs: done and pushed to branch. PR incoming: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842

deploy-bot: PR opened by anna.docs — docs/retention: add cross-region examples and fix Ruby SDK link (PR #842) :github:  

lina.prod: nice! once merged can we add a short blurb in the Console UI help tooltip for retention presets pointing to the doc? small follow-up.

anna.docs: added a follow-up task in the PR description for the Console UX team. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

devon.eng: i'll create the redirect for the old Ruby path and link to the example. ETA EOD.

anna.docs: outstanding, closing this thread after merge. will ping for any wording follow-ups.
